# MultiDatePick

> MultiDatePick is a Salesforce-native Lightning Web Component suite that drops calendar, scheduling, and resource-booking interfaces into Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites with no code. Three components share a configurable base: Date for multi-date selection with ranges and recurring patterns; Date Time for date plus per-date or shared time-slot scheduling with conflict detection; and Booking for resource reservation with capacity tracking, live availability badges, business hours per resource, multi-resource checkboxes, and bulk inline edit mode. The suite renders FIVE interchangeable views from one component (calendar month grid, resource timeline, week-by-hour grid, capacity utilization heatmap, and chronological agenda list), all reading the same records through the same field mappings and saving through the same path, chosen per placement via the view and availableViews properties. The suite ships 65+ configurable properties, six storage shapes (per-date, per-range, per-time-block, parent + sub-blocks, per-resource × date), status-color theming on any picklist, additive-only auto-save, a guided Setup Wizard with JSON import/export and Smart Field Mapping, pre-built configurations, each shipping a default view and switcher list, and built-in translations for 9 languages.

## Core pages

- [MultiDatePick home](https://multidatepick.com/): Salesforce calendar suite for picking many dates, scheduling times and booking rooms, people or equipment. Three components (Date, Date Time, Booking), five views (calendar, timeline, week, utilization, agenda), a Setup Wizard and Screen Flow support. No Apex required. $20/user/month.
- [Set Up MultiDatePick in Salesforce: Getting Started](https://multidatepick.com/gettingstarted.html): Five-step setup with GIFs: install, assign permission sets, build a config in the Setup Wizard (or import one from the Config Library), add the calendar to a Lightning page or a Screen Flow. No Apex required.
- [Salesforce Multi-Date & Range Picker LWC | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdates.html): The Date component. Users click many dates, drag a date range or add recurring patterns; dates save as child records (one per date or one per range) or return to a Screen Flow. Five views, 15 use cases, setup for Lightning pages and Flows, FAQ and the full properties reference.
- [Date Time: Salesforce Date and Time Slot Picker](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdatetime.html): The MultiDatePick Date Time component, a calendar time slot picker for Salesforce Screen Flows, record, App, Home and Experience Cloud pages. Pick many dates, drag times in a grid or use dropdowns, shared or per-date times, conflict detection, periods, status colors, how records save, Flow outputs (selectedDatesWithTimesJson) and the full properties reference.
- [Salesforce Booking Calendar & Resource Scheduler](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-booking-calendar.html): the Booking component. Book rooms, equipment, vehicles and people (any object, including User) with time slots, live capacity badges, conflict detection (block, skip, allow), multi-resource booking, business hours, blocked dates, five views, Experience Cloud self-service, 15 use cases, FAQ and the full settings reference.
- [User Guide - Setup, Configuration & Gotchas | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/user-guide.html): Comprehensive admin guide covering every component, data shape, wizard step, status feature, booking pattern, and common gotcha.
- [App, Home, Experience Pages - Static Record Id | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/home-app-experience.html): Put the calendar on App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Sites with Static Record Id, or drive the parent from a Flow; includes a setup GIF and the four-property Save checklist.
- [Pricing | MultiDatePick for Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/pricing.html): $20 per user per month, one plan with every feature included: no tiers, add-ons or feature gates, all future updates included, and a 30-day free trial of the complete product through AppExchange Checkout.
- [Trust & Security | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/trust.html): Data handling and security: 100% native with no external servers, callouts or subprocessors; passed the Salesforce AppExchange Security Review; all Apex runs in USER_MODE with FLS and sharing enforced.
- [MultiDatePick FAQ | Salesforce Calendar Questions](https://multidatepick.com/faq.html): Common questions about where MultiDatePick runs, its components and views, resource booking, guest sites, Flows, pricing and trial, editions and setup time.
- [Troubleshooting | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/troubleshooting.html): Screenshots of every MultiDatePick setup message (no Save button, wrong component and configuration mismatch banners, the red load-error banner, Booking Configuration Required, No resources available, capacity needs both time fields, max dates reached) with the cause and a fix of three steps or fewer; plus Flow Config Name and Experience Cloud sharing.

## Solutions

- [Salesforce Calendar for Multiple Dates | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar.html): Overview of MultiDatePick as the Salesforce calendar for multiple dates, ranges, recurring schedules, time slots and capacity-limited resource bookings, and why standard date fields and workarounds fall short.
- [Salesforce Calendar for Staffing & Recruiting](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-staffing-recruiting.html): Scheduling for staffing agencies in Salesforce: candidate availability, interview slots, placements and shifts, credential expiry dates, and a recruiter roster using User as the resource.
- [Salesforce Interview Scheduling Calendar](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-interview-scheduling.html): Interview scheduling in Salesforce: date plus time slots on one screen, interviewer or panel resources, conflict handling (block, skip or allow), panel capacity, and candidate self-booking.
- [Salesforce Conference Room Booking Calendar](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-conference-room-booking-calendar.html): Meeting room and desk booking in Salesforce: rooms from any object, per-room business hours, taken slots shown before booking, multi-room booking in one action, and conflict detection.
- [Experience Cloud Booking Calendar | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-experience-cloud-booking.html): Self-service booking on public or member Experience Cloud sites: appointments, availability, rooms and equipment, session enrollment, guest-user setup and record ownership, with all data kept in the org.
- [Salesforce Lightning Scheduler alternative](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-vs-lightning-scheduler.html): Salesforce Lightning Scheduler (now Salesforce Scheduler) compared with MultiDatePick: data model, licensing, Experience Cloud booking, rooms and capacity, a feature table, when to choose which, and an FAQ.

## Blog

- [Salesforce Utilization Heatmap: See Who Is Overbooked](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-utilization-heatmap.html): A utilization heatmap for Salesforce booking records: each resource a row, each day a cell showing booked against capacity, a combined availability row, an average and open column, overbooking ringed in orange, a count fallback without a capacity field, and click-through to that resource's week.
- [Salesforce Campaign Dates: Every Event Day, No Apex](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-campaign-multiple-dates.html): How to track many dates on a Salesforce Campaign by configuration only: a child object with a lookup to Campaign, a Setup Wizard config, and the Dates component on the Campaign record page; each date saved as its own record with status colors, hover details, recurring patterns and edit mode; Flow path via Config Name and Parent Record Id.
- [The Salesforce Timeline View](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-timeline-view.html): A resource timeline for any Salesforce object: resources as rows, multi-day bookings as single bars, lanes for overlaps, a capacity strip, Day, Week and Month zoom, drag to reschedule, and the settings that shape it.
- [An Accessible Salesforce Calendar for Government Teams](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-section-508-government-calendar.html): Accessible scheduling for state, local and federal agencies on Salesforce: the ADA Title II WCAG 2.1 AA deadlines (April 26, 2027 and April 26, 2028), Section 508, why a third-party calendar needs its own accessibility, and how MultiDatePick meets it with ARIA grid semantics, full keyboard support, zero axe-core violations and a published VPAT 2.5.
- [Five Calendar Views, One Salesforce Component](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-views.html): Month grid, resource timeline, week grid, utilization heatmap and agenda views of the same Salesforce booking records, chosen per placement with one config field.
- [Why Salesforce Has No Multi-Date Calendar](https://multidatepick.com/blog/why-salesforce-has-no-multi-date-calendar.html): Why a Salesforce date field holds only one date, what the common workarounds cost, and how a multi-date calendar component fixes it.
- [Configuring a Salesforce Calendar Without Writing Code](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-setup-wizard.html): Configuring a Salesforce calendar component with no code: a Setup Wizard with live preview that saves a reusable, deployable Config__mdt record.
- [Salesforce VPAT: What Admins Need to Know](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-vpat-accessibility.html): What a VPAT is, why it surfaces during Salesforce procurement, how to read its conformance levels, and four questions to ask an AppExchange vendor.
- [Preventing Double-Booking in Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/blog/prevent-double-booking-in-salesforce.html): Why validation and duplicate rules cannot stop overlapping bookings in Salesforce, the difference between conflict and capacity, and catching both at selection time.
- [Building a Calendar Time Slot Picker in Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-time-slot-picker.html): What a real time slot picker in Salesforce has to handle: overlap math, timezones, race conditions and keyboard accessibility.
- [Recurring Date Patterns in Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/blog/recurring-date-patterns-in-salesforce.html): Recurring date patterns beyond Events and Tasks in Salesforce: every other week, nth weekday, last weekday, and whether to store the rule or the dates.
- [How to Let Users Pick Multiple Dates in a Salesforce Screen Flow](https://multidatepick.com/blog/multiple-dates-in-a-salesforce-screen-flow.html): Letting users pick multiple dates in a Salesforce Screen Flow: five workarounds compared and how to return a real date collection to the flow.
